svg.title: ChatVia.ai
svg.desc: ChatVia.ai: self-hosted AI agents that answer from your own knowledge. Knowledge base, tools and MCP, guardrails, channels, analytics, teams, human handoff and a REST API. Works with open-weight and hosted models, messaging channels and many connectors.

g.text: AI agents that answer from your own knowledge.
How do I reset my password?
Open Settings, then Account, and choose
Reset password. We e-mail you a link
